title: Russia diesel policy-state contradiction audit
falsification_result: FALSIFIED_AS_SINGLE_CONDITION_STRUCTURAL_REGIME: sanctions relief is not the only stated path to resumed exports; domestic overproduction is an explicit competing condition.
maturity_change: Causal policy-state taxonomy improves; no model, parameter, anomaly, calibration, or performance maturity increase.

evidence.finding: Putin said Russia would not supply diesel globally until sanctions are lifted.
Deputy PM Novak said Russia could partially lift diesel export restrictions if domestic production exceeds demand.

quantitative_assurance.provenance: Exact ICARUS source commit plus dated Reuters observations.
quantitative_assurance.temporal_integrity: The Oct 2 Novak condition postdates and materially qualifies the Oct 1 Putin statement; states must remain timestamped rather than retroactively collapsed.
quantitative_assurance.realistic_costs: Not applicable to policy-state validation; mandatory before any derived trading-performance claim.
quantitative_assurance.multiple_testing: No performance test performed; instrument/horizon/specification multiplicity remains unresolved.
quantitative_assurance.estimator_validity: A single political statement is not a stable duration estimator when a competing policy escape condition is stated the next day.
quantitative_assurance.data_sufficiency: Insufficient for duration or price-effect estimation; realized export/customs/shipping observations are required.
quantitative_assurance.redundancy_ablation: Separate political statements, formal export rules, refinery production, customs/shipping flows, inventories, and diesel cracks.
quantitative_assurance.oos: No held-out/OOS performance evidence; none claimed.

blockers: Actual October-November Russian diesel export volumes are not yet established.
Implementation hierarchy between presidential rhetoric, government rules, exemptions, and overproduction relief is unresolved.
Russian energy disclosure restrictions impair observability.
No frozen event population, effective-N estimate, multiplicity correction, protected OOS block, or cost-valid trading rule.
next_decisive_experiment: Pre-register a policy-to-flow state model with distinct timestamped states for rhetoric, formal rule, exemption/relief condition, refinery output, realized export flow, inventories, and diesel cracks. Reconstruct historical Russian diesel restriction episodes, cluster dependent announcements, freeze horizons before outcomes, compare statement-only versus formal-rule versus realized-flow models, preserve the final contiguous episode block for OOS, and apply costs only to any surviving trading rule.

aion.finding: Preserve the Oct 1 sanctions condition and Oct 2 overproduction escape condition as separate immutable states; the later observation qualifies rather than rewrites the earlier one.

ascension.finding: The sanctions-linked structural-risk hypothesis cannot gain duration or predictive authority from the Oct 1 statement because a competing relief condition was stated one day later and realized flows remain unverified.

prometheus.finding: Prioritize policy-to-flow state-transition testing over headline-direction studies; preserve failure of a single-condition structural regime as negative evidence.

learning_claim: Durable learning is claimed only if this exact event is successfully persisted and subsequently admitted by the Adaptive Brain's allowlist and Git-blob verification.
